scope: Open web and public-license audio survey for every instrument that is still missing an approved real-instrument recording.
policy_summary: Public audio may become a candidate only when the exact original file, performer/source, commercial redistribution license, and real-instrument identity can be audited. Candidate files are not app assets. Suno, AI music output, VST/sample-library playback, YouTube/CD/streaming extraction, and generic royalty-free background music are not valid core instrument sources.

latest_search_round.method: Wikimedia Commons API file namespace search plus web search for Freesound/open web audio candidates.
latest_search_round.result_summary: A commercially reusable real gaohu solo was approved from Wikimedia Commons. No additional clean, commercially redistributable, single-instrument source was approved for the seven remaining gaps. ChMusic overlaps only already-approved instruments; CCMusic CTIS is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 and cannot be adapted or shipped in a paid app. Exact open-web searches still resolve to mixed performances, VST/sample libraries, stores, or non-redistributable reference media.
latest_search_round.decision: Keep commission_required instruments in real performer procurement; do not relax policy to use YouTube, VST, generic royalty-free loops, or mixed ensemble recordings.

banned_source_categories: Pixabay/generic royalty-free background music without verifiable instrument stem
background music with unclear composition rights
environmental noise that obscures the instrument

evaluated_source_families.name: Wikimedia Commons instrument audio
evaluated_source_families.reason: Some files appear to be real-instrument demonstrations with named authors and CC BY-SA 4.0, but share-alike/attribution treatment and professional listening review must be resolved before any app bundle use.

evaluated_source_families.name: Freesound single-instrument recordings
evaluated_source_families.reason: Some pages describe clean or real recordings and compatible licenses, but original download, local hash capture, noise/instrument-fit review, and professional listening review are still required.

evaluated_source_families.name: QMUL Beijing Opera percussion dataset via Freesound
evaluated_source_families.reason: The dataset has useful studio one-shots for Daluo and Naobo, but app attribution, dataset citation, and fit against generic luo/bo entries must be reviewed before bundling.

evaluated_source_families.name: YouTube demos, lessons, and performances
evaluated_source_families.reason: YouTube audio cannot be ripped or redistributed in the app without direct written license from the rightsholder and performer. These links are reference-only.

evaluated_source_families.name: VST/sample-library product demos
evaluated_source_families.reason: Plugin demos and sample libraries are not verified real-instrument performances for this app. They also create redistribution and authenticity risk.

evaluated_source_families.name: Pixabay/generic royalty-free music and SFX search results
evaluated_source_families.reason: Search results mix background music, community uploads, and possible synthesized or derivative tracks. They are not acceptable core sources unless a specific original real-instrument stem is separately audited.

evaluated_source_families.name: Suno/Udio/generative music APIs
evaluated_source_families.reason: Generative music output may be used only for non-core mockups or marketing ambience. It cannot be sold as a professional guoyue instrument training tone.
